easy.def: A picture or sign that stands for something.
examples: A heart is a symbol of love.
A dove is a symbol of peace.
The flag is a symbol.

more.def: A sign, picture or object that stands for an idea or thing.
examples: A red cross is a symbol that shows help is near.
The dove is a symbol of peace.
The plus sign is the symbol for adding.

easy.def: Feeling sorry for someone who has a problem.
examples: I felt sympathy for her.
We sent a card of sympathy.
He showed sympathy.

more.def: A feeling of sorrow for someone who is hurt or sad.
examples: I felt sympathy for my friend who lost her pet.
We sent a card to show our sympathy.
The nurse showed sympathy to the child.

easy.def: A sign that you are sick.
examples: A cough is a symptom of a cold.
A fever is a symptom.
The symptoms went away.

more.def: A sign of an illness that you can feel or see.
examples: A runny nose is a symptom of a cold.
A fever is a common symptom of the flu.
The doctor asked about her symptoms.
I put syrup on my pancakes.
The syrup is sweet.
Maple syrup is brown.

more.def: A thick, sweet liquid that is poured over food.
examples: I poured syrup on my pancakes.
The syrup was thick and sweet.
Maple syrup comes from tree sap.
The school has a bus system.
Your body has a system for breathing.
A computer system has many parts.

more.def: A set of parts or ideas that work together as a whole.
examples: The subway system carries thousands of people every day.
Your body has a system that carries blood.
Our teacher has a system for handing out papers.
